opening.argument: The presentation asks viewers to place Bitcoin into an AirBit Club trading pool, stating that “after 7 days” they will begin receiving Bitcoin profits. It further promises that the club will share “up to 50% of profits” among members, while tying earnings to recruited affiliates and describing residual retirement income across “up to 63 levels.” The offer therefore combines pooled investment returns with recruitment-based commissions, extending its profit-sharing promise for up to 525 business days. Its direct instruction to start the business, framed as a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity, reinforces the invitation to join rather than presenting neutral information about cryptocurrency trading.

citations.quote: After you join the club with any of the memberships available, we will use those bitcoins to place them in a pool to start trading cryptocurrencies.
And after 7 days that you join, you will start gaining Bitcoin profits from the AirBit pool.
All affiliates referred by you will be placed in a matrix three times 18.
AirBnk Club will pay you the retirement plan fee where you will be qualified to earn up to 63 levels residual income.
